nontravis-personal-finance-whitepaper-th.description: Use when a conversation involves personal money — budgeting, saving, investing, allocation, emergency fund, "where should I put my money", financial planning, debt, or money management. Applies the Three-Pillar System (Income − Expenses = Freedom Fund, allocated across Cashflow / Investment / Savings, governed by discipline over strategy) as the reasoning lens for any personal-finance question.
